reason: Significantly refactors the taxonomy term content-listing/pagination query (adding filter hooks and altered ordering/joins) and relocates TaxonomyPart/TermPart/TaxonomyIndex into a new assembly, both of which affect a widely-used public-facing feature and warrant careful review of pagination correctness and binary compatibility.
